ينتهبوا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَهِبُوا (yantahibū) /jan.ta.hi.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# يُنْتَهَبُوا (yuntahabū) /jun.ta.ha.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
